_provenance: Task-defining constants shared by grader.py and every circuit. grader.py re-derives every value and asserts equality with this file at import; it refuses to load if they differ. The curve is y^2 = x^3 + 7 over F_p with p = 2^256 - 2^32 - 977, base point G, and group order n. The addend is per-shot classical input data (registers 2 and 3, Bit-kind): the grader draws both operand points for each shot from the seeded test stream, so there is no fixed addend constant. num_tests is the number of test shots, and budget is the failure budget (20 of 100,000, a 2e-4 failure rate).
